lei.note: LEI of the legal entity that contracts with customers, if it has one; until then the provider code is vendor:nexops-one

legal_name.note: registered name of that legal entity

name_latin.note: the name in Latin characters, only when the registered name is not

person_type.note: type of person (EBA codelist value), to be taken from the official codelist

hq_country.note: country of the registered office (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)

parent_id_code.note: ultimate parent undertaking, if any (leave null and mark not applicable when there is none)

parent_id_type.note: type of the parent's code (EBA codelist value)
